endpoints.name: zynqmp-te0808
endpoints.note: Bench only: the -devhuk profile's key comes from OP-TEE's fixed development HUK, the same on every chip, so it is refused unless allow_dev_profile is true, and then admitted as 'development-shared-key' trust with a WARNING. Pin aegis-zynqmp-optee-v1 and drop allow_dev_profile once the key comes from the PUF. Fill 'allowed' from 'fleet.py once'.
